role_binding_note: Use explicit uploader and activator temporary credentials/observed principals separately; same account/bucket/domain tuple, separately hashed resource bindings. No key discovery.
new_public_control_fields_proposed: current/retained exact audit and target identities
no_self_referential_executor_sha: Expected executor SHA is supplied to the run and checked against clean HEAD and fresh main; not embedded into its own commit.
permission_diff_corrections_to_old_resou: Provider.observe_resource calls STS GetCallerIdentity plus OSS GetBucketInfo/GetBucketVersioning. Uploader and activator paths both call observe_resource; the latter therefore needs these bucket reads, not OSS Put/Delete.
Uploader needs existing exact-prefix PutObject/GetObject plus bucket-level identity/versioning reads; no List/Delete/ACL/versioning mutation added.
Activator needs current CDN reads, BatchSetCdnDomainConfig, RefreshObjectCaches and DescribeRefreshTaskById; ById Resource:* read is an explicit exception, not falsely domain scoped.
Private origin role, TLS/DNS and provisioning policy remain separately reviewed external diffs; no RAM management rights in the daily publisher.
facts_not_to_guess: fresh full task aggregation beyond observed M2b sample
